title: Salvador: Setting One Idea Against Another

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *en cambio*, *por el contrario*, *al contrario*, *no obstante* and *ahora bien* from B2 Unit 30. Each sets one idea against another in its own way. Salvador is a good place to use them, because its history has a bright side and a hard side. Here they work on Salvador de Bahía.

sections.title: Five markers, five jobs in Salvador
rows: El puerto era un centro del azúcar; en cambio, el interior estaba menos poblado.
*en cambio* compares two things and finds them different
El Pelourinho no es solo un barrio turístico; por el contrario, es memoria de la esclavitud.
*por el contrario* gives the opposite of what was said
—¿Es una ciudad nueva? —Al contrario, se fundó en 1549.
*al contrario* is the short answer in conversation
Fue restaurado en los años noventa; no obstante, muchos vecinos tuvieron que mudarse.
*no obstante* admits a fact and goes on in spite of it
El centro histórico es hermoso. Ahora bien, necesita mantenimiento constante.
*ahora bien* adds a point that limits what you accepted

items.spanish: La Ciudad Baja es el puerto; la Ciudad Alta, en cambio, está sobre el acantilado.
items.english: The Lower City is the port; the Upper City, on the other hand, stands on the cliff.

items.spanish: Salvador no es una ciudad sin raíces africanas; al contrario, tiene muchas.
items.english: Salvador is not a city without African roots; on the contrary, it has many.

items.spanish: El Pelourinho se restauró; no obstante, hubo críticas por la salida de vecinos.
items.english: The Pelourinho was restored; nevertheless, there was criticism about residents leaving.

sections.content: *Pero* is still the everyday word and takes no comma after it. These markers usually start a new clause after a full stop or a semicolon, with a comma after them. Choose by the kind of contrast: a comparison (*en cambio*), the opposite (*por el contrario*, *al contrario*), a fact that does not stop you (*no obstante*) or a limit (*ahora bien*).
